name: Jane Doe
subject: Login broken after update
message: Hi, I cannot log in at all after the latest update. It just shows a blank screen. This is urgent — I need access for my work. Please fix this immediately!

name: Salim
subject: Dark mode support
message: Love the product overall! One thing I'd really love to see is a dark mode option. Spending long hours on the platform and the bright white interface gets tiring on the eyes. Would be a great quality-of-life improvement. Keep up the great work!
